title: Getting around: the interface
summary: A visual guide to the navigation rail, sidebar, and main workspace.

blocks.heading: The desktop layout
paragraphs: SquadHub keeps navigation on the left and your active work in the large workspace beside it.
The narrow navigation rail opens top-level features. The sidebar provides search, quick views, pinned items, workspaces and conversations. The main workspace shows the page or item you selected.
